description.value: Sierra is a conversational AI platform. The page describes it as "The leading conversational AI platform for businesses."
A conversational AI platform that helps businesses improve customer experiences and drive growth.
An enterprise AI company that builds customer-service agents, founded in 2023 by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor.
A San Francisco-based conversational AI company.

product_description.value: Ghostwriter (builds agents from SOPs, transcripts or plain-English goals), Agent Studio (platform for building AI agents), Horizon (long-horizon outcome planning), Insights (conversation analysis, monitors, experiments and observability), and Channels (one agent deployed across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice and ChatGPT).
Ghostwriter, Agent Studio, Horizon, Insights (Explorer, Monitors, Experiments, Observability) and Channels for deploying one agent across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice and ChatGPT.
Agent OS platform for building and running AI agents across chat, voice, SMS, WhatsApp and email. Agent Studio is a no-code builder for customer-experience teams, and the Agent SDK serves developers.

business_model_description.value: Outcome-based pricing, so customers pay only for the value it delivers.

Outcome-based pricing: customers pay based on results rather than seats or usage alone.
